review.notes: Independent review of 22 observations across 11 explicit country/economy mappings. Retrieved the exact UNDP CSV and World Bank API URLs independently: both raw source hashes match the candidate. Parsed the UNDP CSV using Ruby's standard CSV library, independently of the project parser, and checked every selected iso3, provider name and hdi_2023 value. Checked each World Bank country ID, ISO3, provider name, latest non-null year and numeric value, plus response completeness and the 2026-07-13 update metadata. All HDI observations refer to 2023 in HDR 2025; all selected life-expectancy observations refer to 2024, not 2025 or 2026. Confirmed the current UNDP documentation listing links to this CSV; opened UNDP terms, the WDI indicator's license and source metadata, the World Bank summary terms and its current dataset-specific terms. The recorded CC BY 3.0 IGO and CC BY 4.0 with World Bank additional terms, source acknowledgments, rounding notices and no-endorsement statements match these sources. Hong Kong remains a distinct statistical economy rather than mainland China; no observations are expanded to unmapped territories or citizens abroad. This approves the candidate observations and their recorded source metadata only, not publisher endorsement, an aggregate quality-of-life score, causal passport benefits, rendering, deployment or later source revisions. Preserve period, edition, attribution, license links and geographic scope in publication, and recheck UNDP's future editions because its terms require keeping hosted data current.
